violations.text: Pints of ice cream packaged in the food establishment are lacking list of ingredients, quantity of contents and address. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Labeling guidance document was provided at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Observed insect control device stored above food prep areas in the kitchen. PIC removed insect control devices at time of inspection. Insect control devices shall be installed so that the devices are not located over a FOOD preparation area. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/15/2025
Establishment is lacking a garbage/refuse area. A garbage/refuse area should be available wherever garbage is generated to aid in the proper disposal of refuse. New Violation. Correct By: 05/15/2025

The walls in the ware washing area are constructed of wood. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 05/15/2025
